pre_event_context: On 2024-11-25 Cassava reported that RETHINK-ALZ failed its prespecified co-primary endpoints and announced that REFOCUS-ALZ would be discontinued.
On 2025-01-07 Cassava stated that REFOCUS wind-down was in its final stages and that it still intended to report topline REFOCUS results in late Q1/early Q2 2025.
On 2025-03-03 Cassava again stated that REFOCUS topline data were anticipated in late Q1/early Q2 2025.
The March 25, 2025 disclosure reported the prespecified Phase 3 REFOCUS endpoints after the study had been discontinued.
promotion_requirements: All BOE historical snapshots must encode that the trial/program was already discontinued before the data readout.
The catalyst must not be represented as an ongoing active Phase 3 development program at T-60/T-30/T-10/last-complete-session snapshots.
Science, valuation, market-impact and gate reconstruction must use only information available at each cutoff, including the known prior RETHINK failure and REFOCUS discontinuation.
The March 25 clinical result direction may be used only for negative-event stratification until the cohort freeze; stock outcomes remain prohibited.

rows.reason: Actuate publicly announced statistically significant topline Phase 2 results on 2025-05-06. The 2025-05-31 ASCO presentation is a later scientific presentation and cannot be used as the first-public clinical-result event for the same underlying result without explicit material-new-information justification.
rows.required_action: Renormalize the underlying Phase 2 result event to the 2025-05-06 first-public disclosure, then rerun timestamp, deduplication, historical-universe, financing-window, point-in-time and concentration checks from that corrected event date. Do not silently mutate the existing acquisition row and do not use market outcomes to decide whether to retain it.
